description: This file is a shell script used for testing git diff functionalities, including comparing blobs and paths, checking index and mode changes, and verifying diff outputs for various scenarios.

methods.name: run_diff
methods.description: Executes git diff with full-index option and redirects output to diff.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Checks diff output for specific index line matching given sha1s.

methods.name: check_mode
methods.description: Checks diff output for specific mode changes.

methods.name: check_paths
methods.description: Checks diff output for specific file paths.
